overall_goal: Melt the chocolate and butter together, stirring until smooth, and pour the mixture into the prepared batter.

goals.description: Adjust the pan on the cooker and add salt to the mixture.
goals.rationale: The person adjusts the pan on the cooker and adds a pinch of salt to the mixture.

goals.description: Stir the chocolate and butter mixture off the heat to help it melt.
goals.rationale: The person moves the pan off the heat and stirs the chocolate and butter to encourage melting.

goals.description: Briefly reheat and stir the mixture to ensure it is completely melted.
goals.rationale: The person places the pan back on the heat to fully melt the ingredients while stirring continuously.

goals.description: Pour the melted chocolate and butter into the bowl of whisked eggs and sugar.
goals.rationale: The person transfers the smooth, melted chocolate mixture into the bowl containing the rest of the batter.
